{{Top|leg}}
'''Physical countermeasures''' were, like [[Electronic countermeasures/Legends|electronic countermeasures]], devices that were designed to make a ship more difficult to hit. Chaff and [[Flare/Legends|flares]] were both kinds of physical countermeasure.<ref name="Stay on Target">[[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']]</ref>
